visualCharacteristics: Two-column layout on desktop (900px+): image on the left, text column on the right with a title, a paragraph description and a single call-to-action button. Stacks image above text on mobile.
contentPattern: One cell per row: image (with alt text), title (plain text, rendered as h2), description (rich text), call-to-action link (URL + button text).
usage: Use to promote a single piece of content or destination with a supporting image, short headline, a description and one primary action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image + text + single CTA promotion. Use the existing teaser block when a pre-title or multiple actions are needed.
